dataset_name: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE) Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset
cell_chemistry: Lithium Cobalt Oxide (LiCoO2) cathode, graphite anode (18650 cylindrical)

features.battery_id: Identifier of the battery cell under test (B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018)
features.cycle_number: Ordered discharge cycle count starting from cycle 1 to end-of-life
features.rated_capacity_ah: Manufacturer nominal rated capacity in Ampere-hours (2.0 Ah)
features.measured_capacity_ah: Ground-truth usable discharge capacity in Ampere-hours measured during standard CC discharge to cutoff
features.soh_percent: Ground-truth target State of Health as percentage of rated capacity (Target)
features.discharge_duration_s: Total time elapsed in seconds during discharge cycle
features.voltage_start: Initial cell voltage at start of discharge (V)
features.voltage_end: Final cell voltage at end of discharge / cutoff threshold (V)
features.voltage_min: Minimum cell voltage recorded during cycle (V)
features.voltage_max: Maximum cell voltage recorded during cycle (V)
features.voltage_mean: Mean cell voltage across discharge period (V)
features.voltage_std: Standard deviation of cell voltage during discharge (V)
features.temperature_start: Initial cell surface temperature at start of cycle (°C)
features.temperature_max: Maximum cell surface temperature recorded during discharge (°C)
features.internal_resistance_proxy: Initial ohmic IR voltage drop delta_V / delta_I (Ohms)

esp32_hardware_mapping.description: Hardware adapter mapping live ESP32 sensors (INA219 + DHT11) to cell ML features
esp32_hardware_mapping.battery_configuration: 2S Li-ion pack (2 cells in series, nominal 7.4V)
esp32_hardware_mapping.voltage_mapping: Cell voltage = Pack bus voltage (INA219 V) / 2.0
esp32_hardware_mapping.current_mapping: Cell current = Pack load current (INA219 mA) / 1000.0 (in Amperes)
esp32_hardware_mapping.temperature_mapping: Ambient / pack casing temperature from DHT11 (°C)
esp32_hardware_mapping.note_on_leakage: Future cycle measurements and target capacity are strictly excluded from inference feature set.
